findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be at 0ppm Quat. Discussed with PIC, the sanitizing line at triple sink dispenser was not working. Maintenance will service dispenser, PIC remade sanitizer bucket and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Inspector will follow up with facility on 9/14/2026. Ensure santizer solution is prepared and available at the proper concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be coming apart from triple sink to right of dish machine. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced when needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed a significant gap between walk in cooler and freezer and the ceiling. Discussed with PIC, ensure gap is filled. Walls should be easily cleanable with no gaps to prevent dust and debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed a container of sliced peppers to be held pat 7 day date marking limit. Discussed with PIC, item was pulled and discarded. Ensure any TCS food is discarded after 7 day date marking maximum. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed the right cooler door gasket to be coming off. Discussed with PIC, a new gasket will be ordered. Ensure equipment is in good repair and is working to the manufacturer’s standards.  

4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.
